section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analyses: IBM SPSS 22.0 and Amos 22.0 were used to run descriptive statistics, Pearson correlations, and path analysis. The authors tested a single theoretical mediation model (with body appreciation [BAS-2] as exogenous, SC_Engagement and BMI as endogenous, and AAQ and SC_Action as mediators), using maximum likelihood estimation and fit indices (χ2, χ2/df, TLI, CFI, RMSEA).
